cloudscape.title: Cloudscape Volumetric
cloudscape.reload: Apply saves settings and reloads Iris shaders. This can take a few seconds.
cloudscape.saved: Saved; shaders reloaded. Check the active renderer status above.
cloudscape.reset.notice: Defaults are in the draft. Press Apply to save, or Cancel to discard.
cloudscape.reset.tip: Restores the original 0.5 values in this draft only.
cloudscape.apply.failed: Apply failed; previous settings restored. Hover Apply for details.
cloudscape.apply.recoveryFailed: Apply and recovery failed. Old config preserved; restart Minecraft.
cloudscape.config.missing: No config yet. It will be created when you press Apply.
cloudscape.config.migrated: Old config loaded. Apply will save schema 2 and an exact backup of the original file.
cloudscape.config.corrupt: Config is damaged. Defaults are temporary; Apply keeps the damaged file as a recovery copy.
cloudscape.config.future: Config uses a newer schema. Editing is blocked; use the matching mod version.
cloudscape.diagnostic.pending: Cloudscape: waiting for shaderpack source validation.
cloudscape.diagnostic.unsupported: Unsupported shader interface; shaderpack clouds remain active.
cloudscape.diagnostic.changed: Shader sources changed after validation; Cloudscape was bypassed.
cloudscape.diagnostic.noPack: Iris shaderpack is disabled or unavailable.
cloudscape.atlas.smaller: Atlas: smaller compatible size; exact procedural fallback outside.
cloudscape.atlas.unsupported: Atlas unsupported; exact procedural clouds retained.
cloudscape.atlas.noContext: No OpenGL context for atlas probe; procedural clouds retained.
cloudscape.atlas.conflict: Atlas disabled: shaderpack reserves its target or producer pass.
cloudscape.atlas.style: Atlas disabled: shaderpack style selection changed. Procedural clouds retained.
cloudscape.atlas.off: Atlas disabled by settings or voxel layout.
cloudscape.atlas.unused: Atlas not needed for the selected shaderpack style.
cloudscape.atlas.actualSmaller: Atlas reduced to %s (%s MiB); cloud range retained.
cloudscape.enabled.tip: Disable to restore the shaderpack's own clouds. Reloads shaders on Apply.
cloudscape.coverage.tip: Cloud coverage. More coverage can increase rendering cost.
cloudscape.density.tip: Optical cloud density, for both styles.
cloudscape.windSpeed.tip: Cloud translation speed. Shape evolution is controlled separately.
cloudscape.style.tip: Open Iris → Shader Pack Settings → Clouds. Reimagined and Unbound styles are independent of Cloudscape quality; unsaved Cloudscape changes stay in this draft.
cloudscape.reimaginedMorphSpeed.tip: Reimagined only: shape evolution, independent of wind. Zero freezes evolution.
cloudscape.reimaginedTransmission.tip: Reimagined only: light transmission through thin clouds.
cloudscape.reimaginedLightContrast.tip: Reimagined only: contrast of internal cloud lighting.
cloudscape.quality.tip: Original preserves 0.5 budgets. Balanced uses fewer view/reflection/light samples: faster, less accurate. High uses more: slower, finer integration. Presets change only these three budgets; style, range and full resolution are unchanged. Speed is scene dependent.
cloudscape.viewSteps.tip: Maximum view integration samples. Fewer can lose thin details.
cloudscape.reflectionSteps.tip: Reflection integration budget. Reducing it can change reflected detail.
cloudscape.lightSteps.tip: Lighting budget; lower values may change internal shading.
cloudscape.maxDistance.tip: Original: 6000 blocks. Lowering this changes visible range and is a quality reduction.
cloudscape.reimaginedDensityCache.tip: Exact world density reuse for Reimagined. Unsupported hardware/layout uses the original procedural field. Unbound does not need this atlas.
cloudscape.densityAtlasSize.tip: 4096: full-period cache, two 32768×4096 R32F textures, 1 GiB total. 1536: 144 MiB. Smaller sizes retain exact procedural samples outside the cache; range and resolution stay unchanged. Driver limits can reduce the effective size. The 4096 preset needs a 32768-wide texture.
cloudscape.reimaginedTowerStrength.tip: Tower strength in Classic. Varied shapes derive their height profile from family and weather.
cloudscape.reimaginedVoxelSize.tip: Reimagined: 4, 8 or 16 blocks. Only 16 supports the atlas; smaller cells use procedural density.
cloudscape.baseOffset.tip: Vertical offset from the shaderpack cloud altitude, in blocks.
cloudscape.detail.tip: Unbound only: erosion detail in the original density field.
cloudscape.shapeMode.tip: Independent of quality. Varied voxel shapes apply to the Reimagined cloud style; choose the style in Iris.
cloudscape.weatherVariability.tip: Alternates clear, mixed and heavily clouded episodes. Targets change about every 15 simulation minutes with smooth transitions. Vanilla rain and thunder always apply. Disabling keeps the chosen cloud amount. Classic is unchanged.
cloudscape.transitionSeconds.tip: Simulation seconds to approximately 95% of a weather change. Pauses with simulation.
